thesis: Clinical research organization with debt free balance sheet, backlog 3.17B USD (+5.6% YTD), Q3 net awards 873.4M, 9M revenue +16.9% and operating margin 21.3%; new 1.0B USD buyback authorised 2026-10-20. Stock closed 634.98 on 2026-11-05, down 4% on the day.
counterthesis: At 34x TTM earnings and 28x EV/EBIT the price already assumes durable growth. About 41% of revenue is reimbursed pass through cost. Advanced billings supplied about 20% of 9M operating cash flow, so FCF depends on customer prepayments. Book-to-bill statements triggered three 2026 securities suits (dismissed without prejudice in Oct 2026). Biotech funding sensitivity and cancellations were not quantified in what was read.
invalidation: Net awards falling below revenue for two consecutive quarters, backlog shrinking, rising cancellations, or advanced billings reversing so OCF drops below net income.
